The dish looks like a compostable plate about 20 cm across. It holds roughly 4-5 pieces of cooked steak, seared and medium-rare, and together they cover an area of about 9 x 8 cm.

Each piece is probably about 2 cm thick and 4-5 cm long, so I'd put each at roughly 25-30 g. That gives a total of about 110-130 g.

Cooked beef steak runs about 200-250 kcal per 100 g. For about 120 g, that comes to roughly 270 kcal.
